sub_graphs.title: EIP-2028: Calldata Gas Cost Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculation for transaction calldata with reduced non-zero byte pricing

nodes.label: Transaction Calldata Received
nodes.description: Transaction has been received with calldata bytes to be priced

nodes.label: Iterate Over Calldata Bytes
nodes.description: Process each byte in the calldata to determine gas cost

nodes.label: Check Byte Value
nodes.description: Determine if current byte is zero or non-zero

nodes.label: Byte is Zero
nodes.description: Current byte value is 0x00, charge 4 gas (unchanged)

nodes.label: Byte is Non-Zero
nodes.description: Current byte value is non-zero, charge 16 gas (reduced from 68)

nodes.label: Accumulate Gas Cost
nodes.description: Add byte gas cost to total calldata gas

nodes.label: Calldata Gas Calculated
nodes.description: Total gas cost for all calldata bytes has been computed

edges.label: Continue to next byte if more remain

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: External user or L2 system submitting transactions with calldata

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2028: Transaction Gas Limit Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models validation of transaction gas limits with new calldata costs

nodes.label: Transaction Pending Validation
nodes.description: Transaction received, gas limit validation pending

nodes.label: Calculate Intrinsic Gas
nodes.description: Compute minimum gas required: base cost + calldata gas (16 per non-zero, 4 per zero)

nodes.label: Compare Gas Limit
nodes.description: Check if transaction gas limit >= intrinsic gas

nodes.label: Transaction Gas Valid
nodes.description: Transaction has sufficient gas limit for calldata

nodes.label: Transaction Gas Insufficient
nodes.description: Transaction gas limit too low, reject transaction

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: External user or system submitting transactions

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2028: Block Size and Network Propagation
sub_graphs.description: Models the security implications of increased effective block sizes on network efficiency

nodes.label: Block Created by Miner
nodes.description: New block created, potentially with larger calldata due to lower costs

nodes.label: Block Propagation In Progress
nodes.description: Block is being transmitted across the network

nodes.label: Measure Propagation Delay
nodes.description: Track time for block to reach majority of network (delay D in security model)

nodes.label: Delay Within Acceptable Bounds
nodes.description: Network efficiency remains sufficient per Sompolinsky-Zohar model

nodes.label: Delay Excessive
nodes.description: Network delay threatens security (increased orphan rate, reduced main chain efficiency)

edges.label: Miner creates block with calldata-heavy transactions

external_entities.name: Block Producer
external_entities.description: Miner creating blocks with potentially larger calldata payloads

ambiguities.text: The acceptable delay threshold D is referenced but not precisely defined for mainnet conditions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the EIP relies on empirical testing to validate that the new gas costs do not exceed safe delay bounds. Specific thresholds are implementation-dependent.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not address how blob data (future EIP-4844) interacts with calldata gas pricing.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-2028 applies only to traditional calldata. Blob data has separate pricing defined in later EIPs.

implicit_assumptions.description: Network bandwidth and latency characteristics remain within expected bounds for Ethereum mainnet.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If network conditions degrade, larger blocks from cheaper calldata could cause unacceptable propagation delays and reduced chain security.

implicit_assumptions.description: Block producers will not intentionally create maximally-sized blocks to harm network propagation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious block producers could exploit cheap calldata to create blocks that propagate slowly, gaining competitive advantage (selfish mining).

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot economically fill blocks with calldata at the new reduced prices to cause sustained network degradation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Sustained calldata spam attacks could degrade network performance even at 16 gas per byte.
